title: How Many Pawns to BEAT Martin?
summary: Finale of the pawn series vs Martin (250): after beating him with 10, 9 and 3 pawns, he tries with ONLY ONE pawn (king + h-pawn vs Martin's full army), repeating attempts until it works. He pushes h4-h5-h6, takes en passant ('go be great, go do something today, en passant'), promotes and finally mates with the new queen (Qd8#). He notes viewers found ~9 points of material is the tipping point when adding pieces 'the fair way'.
rules: Player (White): king + one pawn on the h-file; Martin (Black): full army.
Retry the same setup until a win (not adding material in this video).
Normal chess rules incl. en passant and promotion.
win_condition: Checkmate Martin with K + 1 pawn (after promotion).
